question: A support team lead wants several colleagues to be able to view and use the same set of onboarding documents and a shared system of custom instructions when chatting with Claude, without each person needing to configure their own settings. Which feature addresses this on a Team or Enterprise plan?
options: A) An artifact exported as a file and emailed to each team member separately
B) A single long chat conversation that is copied and sent to each colleague individually
C) A shared Project that team members are added to with view or edit permissions
D) Research mode configured to fetch the onboarding documents whenever asked
correct_answers: C) A shared Project that team members are added to with view or edit permissions
explanations: Exporting and emailing an artifact distributes a static file rather than providing an ongoing shared workspace with consistent instructions.
Copying and distributing a single chat transcript does not give colleagues an ongoing shared, editable space with consistent instructions and knowledge.

Correct. Team and Enterprise projects can be shared with specific members or the whole organization, with permission levels like 'Can use' and 'Can edit', giving everyone consistent access to the same knowledge base and instructions.
Research mode searches the web and connected sources on demand; it is not a mechanism for sharing a persistent internal knowledge base and instructions among team members.
